decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly reanimate powerful creatures such as Griselbrand and Emrakul, utilizing spells like Goryo's Vengeance, Reanimate, and Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Thoughtseize, Unmask, and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal are used to accelerate mana generation, allowing for explosive plays. The inclusion of Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Dauthi Voidwalker provides additional flexibility and protection, making this deck a formidable combo-reanimator archetype in the Legacy format.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and counter magic like Force of Will. It also includes versatile removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Kolaghan's Command to deal with threats. The deck utilizes card draw spells like Ponder and Brainstorm to find answers and card advantage engines like Baleful Strix to outvalue opponents. The deck also includes powerful threats like Snapcaster Mage and Barrowgoyf to close out the game. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and win with efficient threats.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly establish control over the board by using small aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to keep up pressure on the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Wasteland and Lightning Bolt. The overall strategy is to maintain card advantage and tempo to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The key idea of this Doomsday combo deck is to quickly assemble the necessary components to cast Doomsday, set up a winning pile with Thassa's Oracle, and win the game on the spot. Utilizing cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal for fast mana acceleration, along with cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig through the deck efficiently, the deck aims to overpower opponents with its powerful win condition. By carefully planning out its strategy and protecting its combo with counterspells like Force of Will, the deck can swiftly secure victory in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on utilizing Cloudpost and Tron lands to ramp up mana quickly, while controlling opponents with disruptive spells like Disruptor Flute and Karn, the Great Creator. It aims to assemble a powerful board state with big creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, supported by powerful artifacts like The One Ring and Planar Nexus. Crop Rotation and Once Upon a Time help find key pieces, while cards like Bojuka Bog and Glacial Chasm provide protection and graveyard hate. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its ramp and versatile threats.

The core strategy of this Aggro - Canadian Threshold deck is to control the early game with counterspells and removal while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler. By utilizing powerful cards like Wasteland and Daze to disrupt the opponent's mana base, the deck aims to maintain tempo advantage and overwhelm the opponent with threats. The versatility of cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm allows for consistent card selection and ensures a smooth curve of threats throughout the game.

The deck focuses on using the Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor combo to fill the graveyard with Narcomoebas and ultimately win the game by casting Dread Return to bring back a key creature like Thassa's Oracle and winning the game through its ability. The deck also includes protection spells like Force of Will and Daze to ensure the combo goes off successfully. The deck features some utility lands like Urza's Saga and Cavern of Souls to help support the combo strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then using cards like Animate Dead and Reanimate to bring them back onto the battlefield for a strong combo finish. Control elements like Force of Will and Brainstorm help protect the combo pieces, while disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Wasteland disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also has some creature removal in the form of Fatal Push and Brazen Borrower to deal with threats. Overall, the key strategy is to reanimate powerful creatures and overwhelm the opponent with a quick combo.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bringing them back onto the battlefield for a powerful and fast win condition. It also includes disruption elements like Force of Will and Hymn to Tourach to control the opponent. The key strategy is to efficiently reanimate high-impact creatures like Archon of Cruelty or Atraxa, Grand Unifier while protecting the combo with counter spells and hand disruption, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a powerful board presence and winning the game in a few turns.

The deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures from the graveyard, utilizing cards like Animate Dead, Reanimate, and Entomb to bring back high-impact creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. It also includes disruption spells like Daze, Force of Will, and Thoughtseize to protect the combo. The deck also incorporates land destruction with Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces, reanimate a powerful threat, and control the game until victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting, then bring them back onto the battlefield using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The focus is on reanimating big threats like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty early in the game to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruption and control elements with cards like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to protect the combo. The goal is to create a fast and powerful reanimator strategy to win the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures from the graveyard, such as Murktide Regent, Archon of Cruelty, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. This is achieved through cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead, while using counterspells like Daze and Force of Will to protect the combo. The deck also utilizes control elements like Thoughtseize, Brazen Borrower, and Troll of Khazad-dûm to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain board presence. Additionally, the deck includes key lands like Wasteland and Underground Sea to maintain the mana base and disrupt the opponent's lands.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently dump your entire deck into the graveyard to win the game through the use of combos and spells. This is achieved by using cards such as Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer to mill your deck, while also utilizing cards like Dread Return and Reanimate to bring back key creatures. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Pact of Negation to protect your combo pieces. Additionally, cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal help ramp up your mana for more powerful plays.

The deck focuses on using various spells to quickly put powerful creatures into the graveyard, then reanimating them onto the battlefield for a quick win. It utilizes cards like Entomb, Animate Dead, and Reanimate to fuel this strategy, while also running disruption in the form of Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo. The creatures chosen for reanimation, such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, have strong abilities that can turn the tide of the game in the player's favor. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with large threats early on.

This Aggro - Dragon Stompy deck focuses on quickly dropping powerful creatures and disrupting opponents with cards like Chalice of the Void, Magus of the Moon, and Blood Moon. The deck utilizes mana acceleration from cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to cast big threats like Fury, The One Ring, and Pyrogoyf. By locking down opponents' lands and spells while constantly applying pressure, this deck aims to overwhelm and control the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to quickly bring back high-impact creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. It also uses disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo and disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck also includes cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for key pieces and ensure consistency. With a mix of aggressive reanimation and control elements, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with big threats and powerful synergy.
